title: Do LP2 grid bytes track doublet gaps?
question: Do fixed-width or varint readings of the LP2-49–51 payload correlate with distances between adjacent equal-rune events in LP2?
summary: Seven declared readings of the pinned 256-byte payload show no strong rank alignment with 85 doublet gaps or the related 86-value sequence.
finding: Among 14 fixed comparisons, the largest absolute Spearman rank correlation is 0.119, below the published 0.5 effect-size gate. For the primary 85-gap target, 83 of 84 nonzero circular alignments have an equal or larger best-of-seven correlation than the unshifted comparison.
limitations: Only seven direct readings, byte-zero alignment and two gap definitions are tested. Circular rotations are dependent descriptive controls, not a cipher null. Other byte transcriptions, transforms, offsets, selections and gap definitions remain open.
next_steps: A revised gap-encoding claim should fix its exact byte source, decoding, offset and target sequence before searching, then repeat the complete selection procedure on controls.

scope.representation: Pinned 256-byte source grid and 86 within-page equal-rune-pair starts on archived LP2-00–55, concatenated in page order for gap distances.
scope.procedure: Decode seven fixed integer/varint readings at byte zero. Compare first available values with 85 inter-event distances and with the first one-based event coordinate plus those distances using tie-aware Spearman correlation. Audit all 84 nonzero rotations of the 85-gap target with the best-of-seven statistic.
scope.parameters: Seven byte readings; two targets; 14 comparisons; 85 gap distances; 84 alignment controls; published effect-size gate |rho| >= 0.5.
scope.exclusions: Other payload transcriptions, starting offsets, byte permutations, transforms, noncontiguous selections, distinct event definitions, and inference of a cipher mechanism.

review.reviewer: Independent pairwise midrank check and planted varint round trip

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library; experiment bundle and reference-data bundle extracted together.

visuals.caption: All seven fixed byte readings have weak absolute rank correlation with the 85-gap sequence; none approaches the published 0.5 effect-size gate.

reader_note: Seven literal byte readings fail the declared doublet-gap correlation gate.
reader_limit: Only fixed byte-zero readings and two event-gap definitions are tested.
scope_summary: LP2-49–51 grid · LP2-00–55 doublets · 14 fixed comparisons.
